title: Explainer-How could New Mexico's $567 million ruling change Meta?
title_zh: 解释者-新墨西哥州5.67亿美元的裁决如何改变Meta？
summary: Aug 7 (Reuters) - A New Mexico state court ordered Meta Platforms, owner of Facebook and Instagram, to make major changes to its platforms and pay the largest sum yet in a growing wave of U. litigation over claims that social media harms young people.
summary_zh: 8 月 7 日（路透社） - 新墨西哥州法院命令 Facebook 和 Instagram 的所有者 Meta Platforms 对其平台进行重大改变，并在美国因社交媒体伤害年轻人的指控而提起的越来越多的诉讼中支付迄今为止最大的一笔赔偿金。

Berkshire investors seem to be warming up to Greg Abel's leadership. 👀

The recent gains have been fueled by a rotation back into safe-haven plays to hedge against riskier tech stocks.

Although it's worth noting that the stock is still badly lagging the S&P 500.
